answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can influence reputation or claim rewards, and cap each stake’s influence so one account cannot dominate. A newcomer at the inlet can build standing only through repeated, independently verified work; the summit of trust takes time, while proven fraud burns the stake. A sybil attacker must therefore lock real capital in every fake identity and risk losing it, making a mass of disposable accounts costly rather than free, even if the dune of identities looks convincing.
